snippet.title: RAD Gameplay Trailer 2
snippet.description:
RAD is a momentum-driven platformer inspired by flow, experimentation, and progression. Discover new lines, master movement, and learn to see your environment in new ways.

Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/854850/RAD/

Other links + social
https://linktr.ee/radthegame

Every mechanic interacts with the world differently. Experiment, combine abilities, and uncover creative solutions that build speed and open new possibilities. The fun is in discovering what's possible.

Every personal best is saved to the global leaderboard with a ghost. Race your own runs or study anyone else's. Learn their lines, understand their decisions, and discover new approaches to movement. There are no hidden techniques; just skill, creativity, and practice.

The deeper you go, the more the game reveals. What begins as simple movement becomes a constant process of experimentation, discovery, and refinement.

RAD has been built around the things we love most about games: freedom, mastery, and the satisfaction of finding a better line.

We hope you enjoy the journey.

See you on the leaderboard.

#RADTheGame #Speedrunning  #indiegame #pcgaming #movementgame
